title: Entry into force of landmark Vanuatu-Australia Nakamal Agreement
summary: Prime Minister of Australia, the Hon Anthony Albanese MP and Prime Minister of Vanuatu, the Hon Jotham Napat, today announce the entry into force of the historic Vanuatu–Australia Nakamal Agreement.The Nakamal Agreement is a comprehensive, legally binding agreement. It elevates our bilateral relationship and strengthens our economic, security, humanitarian and people-to-people cooperation.
